reason: no_reward: the ethereum deployment is the tornado-core mixer itself - the 4 ETH pools expose only deposit(bytes32) and withdraw(proof,root,nullifier,recipient,relayer,fee,refund) (plus dead onlyOperator admin, operator() reads 0x0), and there is no reward/claim/harvest/distribute/keeper function anywhere. withdraw is callable by anyone but verifier.verifyProof binds recipient, relayer, fee and refund, so the note owner picks who is paid off-chain inside the ZK proof: a stranger cannot call it and take the fee (eth_call from a fresh address reverts 'Cannot find your merkle root', an input revert, not a role revert). Out of scope for the farm under constraint S anyway (no mixers / privacy pools).
